alt: Sunrise light over flooded Hani rice terraces stepping down a mountainside at Duoyishu in March
caption: Sunrise over the flooded Hani terraces at Duoyishu, Yuanyang. This is the day-5 dawn the trip is built around; March is when the paddies are still water-filled and reflect the sky.

alt: Tiled grey roofs and canal-side lanes of the Naxi Old Town of Lijiang
caption: Lijiang's Naxi old town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site of canals and tiled roofs. It is the base for days 10-11, before the Tiger Leaping Gorge walk.

alt: The Jinsha River running between the steep walls of Tiger Leaping Gorge
caption: The Jinsha (upper Yangtze) River squeezed between Jade Dragon and Haba snow mountains in Tiger Leaping Gorge. Day 11 follows the high trail above this drop, with a night in a gorge guesthouse.

alt: The Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple in front of the Cangshan range at Dali
caption: The Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple, Dali, set against the Cangshan range. A short walk from Dali Old Town on day 7, they are the Bai kingdom's best-known monument.

alt: A street of old timber and stone houses in Shaxi, a former Tea Horse Road caravan town
caption: A lane of old timber houses in Shaxi, the last surviving market town of the Tea Horse Road. Day 9 is spent here, sleeping in a restored caravan inn.

alt: Snow-covered peaks of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain above the Lijiang plain
caption: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain (about 5,600 m) rising over the Lijiang plain. It is the backdrop to day 10 and shows why the Naxi treat the range as sacred.

alt: Courtyard and pavilions of the Zhu Family Garden in Jianshui
caption: The Zhu Family Garden, a late-19th-century Suzhou-style garden in Jianshui. It is the cultural stop of day 3, before the drive into Hani country.

alt: The gilded roofs and white walls of Songzanlin Tibetan Buddhist monastery near Shangri-La
caption: Songzanlin Monastery on the hillside above Shangri-La, the Tibetan Buddhist high point of the route at about 3,300 m. Day 12 is its visit, and the altitude is the practical challenge.

commonsFile: File:1 yuanyang county rice terrace bada view 2012.jpg
alt: Sea of cloud filling the valleys below Hani rice terraces and a village at Bada
caption: Terraces and a Hani village seen from Bada, one of the three Yuanyang viewpoint clusters. Day 5's afternoon visit adds this to the Duoyishu sunrise.

alt: Grey-tiled roofs and lanes of Xizhou Old Town near Dali
caption: Xizhou, a Bai merchant town north of Dali with whitewashed courtyard houses. On day 8 it is the first stop on the Erhai circuit.

alt: The shore of Erhai Lake near Dali with the Cangshan range beyond
caption: Erhai Lake, the plateau lake that the Bai villages of day 8 are strung around. The cycling stretch follows its shore.

alt: The Ming-dynasty Bai Buddhist Xingjiao Temple beside Sideng square in Shaxi
caption: Xingjiao Temple, a Ming-dynasty Bai Buddhist temple facing Shaxi's Sideng square. It is on day 9's walk around the caravan town.

location: Tiger Leaping Gorge trail, between Qiatou and Walnut Grove
alt: A stretch of the Tiger Leaping Gorge high trail on a hillside above the village fields
caption: A section of the Tiger Leaping Gorge trail between Qiatou and Walnut Grove. Day 11 walks this high route in about a day, ending at a gorge guesthouse.
